tasks.title: Validate ISBNs on the server
phrasings: `POST /books` accepts any string as an ISBN. Reject invalid ones with 400 `bad_request`. Valid means an ISBN-10 (the last character may be `X`) or an ISBN-13, each with a correct check digit; hyphens and spaces in the input are allowed and are removed before the ISBN is stored. Add contract tests for valid and invalid ISBNs.

Stop bad ISBNs getting onto the shelf. `POST /books` should answer 400 `bad_request` unless the ISBN is a valid ISBN-10 (whose last character may be `X`) or ISBN-13, including a correct check digit. People type hyphens and spaces, so accept them, but strip them before saving the ISBN. Add contract tests covering valid and invalid ISBNs.

Right now `POST /books` takes any ISBN string. Validate it: accept an ISBN-10 (last character may be `X`) or an ISBN-13, either with a correct check digit, allowing hyphens and spaces in the input and storing the ISBN without them; anything else gets 400 `bad_request`. Add contract tests for both valid and invalid ISBNs.

tasks.title: Add-book form
phrasings: Add an "Add a book" form to the web front end, in `src/client/views.ts`. First `validateNewBook(input: NewBook)`, which returns an object with an error message for each invalid field (and `{}` when all is well): title and author must not be blank, copies must be a whole number from 1 to 50, and isbn must be a valid ISBN-10 (the last character may be `X`) or ISBN-13 with a correct check digit, ignoring hyphens and spaces. Then `renderAddBookForm(values, errors)`, which renders the four fields with their current values and each field's error next to it. Add unit tests.

The web front end needs a form for adding books, in `src/client/views.ts`. Write `validateNewBook(input: NewBook)` to check a new book before it's sent: it returns `{}` when everything is fine, otherwise an object with a message for each bad field. Rules: title and author can't be blank; copies is a whole number from 1 to 50; isbn is a valid ISBN-10 (last character may be `X`) or ISBN-13 with a correct check digit, with hyphens and spaces ignored. Also write `renderAddBookForm(values, errors)`, rendering the four fields with their values and any error beside its field. Add unit tests.

Build the "Add a book" form in `src/client/views.ts`, with validation before submit. `validateNewBook(input: NewBook)` returns a per-field object of error messages, or `{}` if the book is fine: title and author not blank, copies a whole number between 1 and 50, and isbn a valid ISBN-10 (an `X` is allowed as the last character) or ISBN-13 whose check digit is correct, ignoring any hyphens and spaces. `renderAddBookForm(values, errors)` renders the four inputs filled with `values`, each followed by its error if there is one. Add unit tests.
